layers.description: Direct 17x17x17 3D colour table fitted on flat blurred areas with Laplacian smoothness regularizer.
After Effects Unsharp Mask on luma channel matching line-art crispness and halo profiles.

rejected_or_absent_effects.reason: Evaluated real bloom against target; does not reduce error or match target background (no excess physical bloom beyond source).
Flat-area noise analysis shows video compression blockiness; no intentional film grain added.
Directional gradient worsens held-out error (median DE00 drops from 2.11 to 4.98); 3D LUT captures the full tonal grade.
No radial corner darkening detected; corners are bright.
Shadow blacks remain solid; no black lift veil.

honest_limits.dominant_limiter: Source video compression artifacts and target subtitle overlay in pairA
honest_limits.description: PairA contains burned-in subtitles in target, and PairB original source has lower resolution (720x409) rescaled to 1291x720 causing resampling blur. The 3D LUT + Unsharp Mask accurately reconstructs the full color correction and line crispness.
